lyrics: [Intro] [Spoken deadpan narration over dry upright bass and snapping tambourine] The asset is verified. The asset is entirely vacant. We begin our descent into structural impossibility. [Music kicks in with a greasy fuzz guitar riff and a deep pocket groove] [Verse 1] [Stacked doo-wop backing vocals singing nonsense syllables] Sha-na-na, the invoice is an orchard. The receipt is a migrating heron. You held the ledger upside down and let the vowels fall on the linoleum floor. Every promise made was a three-legged mule trotting across a frozen interstate at midnight. The semantic barometer reads ninety percent humidity in a desert of pure porcelain. [Chorus] [Massed vocal harmony, high energy, brass stabs] Oh, the transaction was gorgeous! The trousers were made of pure weather! We traded our vertebrae for a slightly used trombone! When the paperwork burns, the ash smells like Tuesday afternoon! Shake it until the classification falls off the bone! [Verse 2] [Fast patter singing, syncopated rhythm, slapback delay] Classify the breakfast as an act of treason. Classify the sidewalk as an affectionate uncle. The geometry of the lobby does not permit your exit. You have twenty minutes to explain why the sofa is speaking fluent Latin. It is not a metaphor. The sofa is conjugating verbs in the third-person plural while sweating velvet. [Bridge] [Tempo slows down, heavy organ swells, dramatic falsetto cry] Where does the debt go when the coin dissolves into blue ink? We measure the weight of a forgotten favor using a rusty kitchen scale. The numbers do not match the fruit. The fruit does not match the tree. The tree is currently renting an apartment in downtown Toledo. [Guitar Solo] [Abrasive, blues-inflected fuzz guitar tearing through the tape saturation, drums pushing a heavy backbeat] [Verse 3] [Call-and-response between dry lead and gospel choir] Did you check the seals? The seals are made of damp cardboard and bureaucratic enthusiasm. Every time you open the filing cabinet, a flock of pigeons escapes into the ventilation system. They carry the quarterly report directly to the clouds. [Chorus] [Explosive full-band return, screaming vocal ad-libs] Oh, the transaction was gorgeous! The trousers were made of pure weather! We traded our vertebrae for a slightly used trombone! When the paperwork burns, the ash smells like Tuesday afternoon! Shake it until the classification falls off the bone! [Outro] [Instruments drop out one by one until only an out-of-tune upright piano and a single tambourine remain] The ledger is closed. The mule has arrived at the tollbooth. The sofa is asleep. Goodnight, asset. [Silence]
caption: A vintage soul and rock-and-roll collision where impossible ontological identities dictate the lyrical and musical architecture. Driven by retro grooves, fuzz guitar, and stacked doo-wop harmonies, it treats bureaucratic administrative language as physical scenery while lossy cognition and category errors tear the structure apart from the inside out.
